 Mostly sunny with highs in the mid-50s Monday; near 60 Tuesday, then 60s midweek with no rain in sight — our CapitalWeather.com weekly Sunday 6pm livestream here and on our socials: 
 Facebook: CapitalWeather 
 X: @CapitalWeather 
 YouTube: @CapitalWeather 
 Instagram: @CapitalWeather 
 TikTok: @Capitalweather 
 Weekly chats are at 6 p.m. until daylight saving time returns in mid-March.

 Forecast posts (tag "Forecasts" on their own page; title starting "DC-area forecast" on the
 live blog) never get automatic boxes, for any reader. For logged-out visitors, their built-in
 Signup CTA is replaced by a Download app CTA until the reader has seen the forecast's built-in
 Support CTA 3 times; after that the bottom CTA alternates Signup / Download app on each visit.

 per browser. Change SEEN_NEEDED in the script to use a different number.)
